notes.description: JSON prompts used to generate facial expression transition stimuli.
notes.version_info: This file contains separate prompt specifications for happy and angry expression versions.

happy_version.comment: Happy expression generation prompt. Intensity increases from neutral to happy.
happy_version.task: Generate 20 separate happy-expression images from a single neutral reference image.
happy_version.goal: Using only the neutral reference image, generate 20 new images in which happiness increases gradually and naturally from 5% to 100% in 5% increments.

angry_version.comment: Angry expression generation prompt. Intensity increases from neutral to angry.
angry_version.task: Generate 20 separate angry-expression images from a single neutral reference image.
angry_version.goal: Using only the neutral reference image, generate 20 new images in which anger increases gradually and naturally from 5% to 100% in 5% increments.

task: Generate 20 separate happy-expression images from a single neutral reference image.
goal: Using only the neutral reference image, generate 20 new images in which happiness increases gradually and naturally from 5% to 100% in 5% increments, while keeping all non-expression features unchanged.
core_instruction: Start from the neutral face and create a smooth monotonic increase in happiness. happy_005 should be almost neutral with only the faintest trace of a smile. Each subsequent image should be slightly happier than the previous one. happy_100 should show a fully happy expression that still looks natural for the same person.
expression_guidelines: Gradually increase subtle eye-smile and warmth around the eyes.
Keep the progression continuous and perceptually even.
Make adjacent images differ only very slightly.
Avoid sudden jumps in smile intensity between neighboring frames.
If teeth become visible, introduce them gradually and naturally only at higher intensity levels.
continuity_requirements: The expression intensity must increase smoothly and continuously from 5% to 100%.
Each image must look like a natural continuation of the previous and next image.
happy_005 must be very close to neutral.
happy_100 must represent the strongest happy expression in the sequence, while still remaining realistic.
identity_and_visual_lock: Preserve the exact same person identity.
Preserve the exact same facial structure, head position, gaze direction, hairstyle, clothing, and body posture.
Preserve the exact same framing, crop, camera angle, perspective, lighting, color tone, sharpness, and background.
Do not change age, skin tone, hair, clothes, or image composition.

output_format.instruction: Generate 20 separate full-resolution image files, one for each happiness level. Do not combine multiple faces into one image.

negative_constraints: No text labels inside the image.
No unintended emotions such as anger, sadness, fear, disgust, contempt, or surprise.

task: Generate 20 separate angry-expression images from a single neutral reference image.
goal: Using only the neutral reference image, generate 20 new images in which anger increases gradually and naturally from 5% to 100% in 5% increments, while keeping all non-expression features unchanged.
core_instruction: Start from the neutral face and create a smooth monotonic increase in anger. angry_005 should be almost neutral with only the faintest trace of anger. Each subsequent image should be slightly angrier than the previous one. angry_100 should show a fully angry expression that still looks natural for the same person.
expression_guidelines: Gradually draw the eyebrows slightly downward and inward.
Gradually increase tension around the eyes.
Gradually increase tension around the nose bridge and upper face.
Gradually tighten the lips and mouth area.
Keep the progression continuous and perceptually even.
Make adjacent images differ only very slightly.
Avoid sudden jumps in frowning intensity between neighboring frames.
continuity_requirements: The expression intensity must increase smoothly and continuously from 5% to 100%.
Each image must look like a natural continuation of the previous and next image.
angry_005 must be very close to neutral.
angry_100 must represent the strongest angry expression in the sequence, while still remaining realistic.
identity_and_visual_lock: Preserve the exact same person identity.
Preserve the exact same facial structure, head position, gaze direction, hairstyle, clothing, and body posture.
Preserve the exact same framing, crop, camera angle, perspective, lighting, color tone, sharpness, and background.
Do not change age, skin tone, hair, clothes, or image composition.

output_format.instruction: Generate 20 separate full-resolution image files, one for each anger level. Do not combine multiple faces into one image.

negative_constraints: No text labels inside the image.
No unintended emotions such as happiness, sadness, fear, disgust, contempt, or surprise.
